_meta.source: MOE Full SBB pages, SEAB SEC overview, MOE SchoolFinder guidance. Written for parents of the first SEC cohorts.
_meta.notes: One calm page. The parent is very often the person actually driving the subject combination decision, working from the system they went through, which no longer exists. Tone rules: never tells a parent they are wrong, never ranks routes, no dashes.

title: For parents
lede: The system your child is in is not the one you went through. Here is the shape of it, in five minutes.

sections.head: What changed since your day
sections.body: Express, Normal Academic and Normal Technical are gone. Since 2024 your child takes each subject at its own level, G1, G2 or G3, and can mix them. The O and N Levels became one exam, the SEC, first sat in 2027. And the JAE you remember is replaced from 2028 by one Post Secondary Admissions Exercise covering JC, MI, poly, PFP and ITE on a single portal.

sections.head: What G1, G2 and G3 actually are
sections.body: Levels of a subject, not a rank of your child. G3 covers the most ground fastest, G1 is the most practical. A student can hold G3 English beside G2 Maths. Levels move: schools shift students up and down every year, on classwork, not on one paper.

sections.head: When the decisions happen
sections.body: Sec 1 and 2: levels settle and can move. Mid Sec 2: the subject combination exercise, the one that feels enormous and is adjustable. Sec 3: the combination runs. Sec 4: Early Admissions opens before results, on interest and evidence, then the main posting after results. A fifth year exists so one set of results does not settle everything.

sections.head: Five conversations that help
items: Ask what they enjoy before you ask what they scored.
Go to one open house together, including one route you had not considered.
Ask the subject teacher what moving up a level would take.
Ask them to show you this tool and their three actions for the term.
Ask the ECG counsellor anything. It is their job and it is free.

sections.head: Three that quietly hurt
items: Comparing with cousins and colleagues' children. Different child, different road.
Treating one route as the real one and the rest as fallbacks. The salary data does not support it and neither does the system.
Deciding for them. A route a child chose survives a hard year better than a route chosen for them.

sections.head: Where the official answers live
sections.body: moe.gov.sg for criteria, SchoolFinder for what each school runs, and your child's school for what is actually on offer, since schools run different subsets of subjects and lists change between cohorts. This tool is for thinking, not deciding: the headline 2028 figures match what MOE has announced, and anything not yet read from a primary page is marked provisional on screen.

windows.label: Subject combination exercise
windows.when: Mid Sec 2, around May to July
windows.what: The school runs briefings and the form goes home. Levels can still move after it, every year.

windows.label: Direct admission, DSA
windows.when: May to July of Sec 4, for JC
windows.what: Talent based entry to a JC before results, on CCA and portfolio evidence. The Sec 1 version is behind you; this one is not.

windows.label: Early Admissions, EAE
windows.when: About June of Sec 4, before results
windows.what: Poly and ITE admission on interest and evidence, before the exam. The folder it needs is built in Sec 3.
windows.check: Polytechnic EAE and ITE EAE pages

windows.label: Open houses
windows.what: JC, MI, poly and ITE campuses open around results season. Going to one changes more minds than any brochure.

windows.label: The main posting round
windows.what: One PSE portal from 2028 for JC, MI, poly, PFP and ITE, replacing the JAE you remember.

guest.head: Play your own school years
guest.body: The game your child plays, but as you at fourteen: your old stream, translated into today's levels. Ten minutes, on this phone, and nothing your child saved here is read or touched.
guest.opens: That combination, in today's system, keeps {n} of the {total} destinations reachable.
guest.note: Opens as a guest. The game saves nothing to this phone, and handing it back leaves everything exactly as it was.

windowsHead: The windows, roughly when they open
windowsNote: Months drift from year to year, so every row needs checking against the named page. The knowledge is the order, and that none of these should arrive as a surprise.

changes.head: PSLE scored in Achievement Levels
changes.body: Each subject gets AL1 to AL8. The PSLE Score is their sum, from 4 to 32.

changes.head: Streams end
changes.body: No more Express or Normal streams. Each subject is taken at G1, G2 or G3.

changes.head: One exam, the SEC
changes.body: The Singapore Cambridge Secondary Education Certificate replaces the O and N Levels.

changes.head: New admission rules
changes.body: JC counts five subjects. Polytechnic counts one subject at G2. One admissions exercise covers them all.

thenNow.head: Your stream, in today's words
thenNow.note: The change: your child takes each subject at its own level, and a level can move.
